Tomato_Early_blight.description: Fungal disease causing dark spots with concentric rings on lower leaves.
Tomato_Early_blight.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicide every 7-10 days. Remove infected leaves immediately.
Tomato_Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops yearly. Avoid overhead watering. Ensure good air circulation.

Tomato_Late_blight.description: Aggressive fungal disease causing water-soaked lesions on leaves and stems.
Tomato_Late_blight.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb fungicide immediately. Remove and destroy infected plants.
Tomato_Late_blight.prevention: Use resistant varieties. Avoid wet foliage. Apply preventive fungicide in humid weather.

Tomato_Leaf_Mold.description: Fungal disease causing yellow patches on upper leaf surface and olive-green mold below.
Tomato_Leaf_Mold.treatment: Apply fungicide containing chlorothalonil. Improve greenhouse ventilation.
Tomato_Leaf_Mold.prevention: Reduce humidity below 85%. Space plants for airflow. Avoid wetting leaves.

Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.description: Fungal disease causing small circular spots with dark borders on leaves.
Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Apply copper or chlorothalonil fungicide. Remove infected lower leaves.
Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Mulch around plants. Rotate crops. Stake plants to improve air circulation.

Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.description: Tiny mites causing stippled yellowing on leaves, especially in hot dry conditions.
Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.treatment: Apply miticide or neem oil spray. Increase humidity around plants.
Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.prevention: Monitor regularly. Avoid water stress. Introduce predatory mites as biocontrol.

Tomato__Target_Spot.description: Fungal disease causing circular target-like lesions on leaves and fruit.
Tomato__Target_Spot.prevention: Remove crop debris. Rotate crops. Avoid overhead irrigation.

Tomato__Tomato_YellowLeaf__Curl_Virus.description: Viral disease spread by whiteflies causing leaf curling and yellowing.
Tomato__Tomato_YellowLeaf__Curl_Virus.treatment: No cure available. Remove and destroy infected plants immediately to prevent spread.
Tomato__Tomato_YellowLeaf__Curl_Virus.prevention: Control whitefly populations. Use reflective mulch. Plant resistant varieties.

Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.description: Viral disease causing mottled light and dark green patterns on leaves.
Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: No cure available. Remove infected plants. Disinfect tools with bleach solution.
Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds. Wash hands before handling plants.

Tomato_Bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial disease causing small water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit.
Tomato_Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericide. Remove heavily infected plant parts.
Tomato_Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use disease-free seeds. Avoid overhead irrigation. Rotate crops.

Tomato_healthy.description: Plant appears healthy with no signs of disease.
Tomato_healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Continue regular care.
Tomato_healthy.prevention: Maintain regular watering, fertilization and monitoring schedule.

Potato___Early_blight.description: Fungal disease causing dark spots with yellow halos on older leaves.
Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply mancozeb or chlorothalonil fungicide every 7-14 days.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Use certified seed potatoes. Rotate crops. Maintain plant nutrition.

Potato___Late_blight.description: Devastating fungal disease that can destroy entire crop within days.
Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply metalaxyl or cymoxanil fungicide immediately. Destroy infected plants.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Use resistant varieties. Apply preventive fungicide. Avoid overhead irrigation.

Potato___healthy.description: Plant appears healthy with no signs of disease.
Potato___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Continue regular care.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Maintain regular watering, fertilization and monitoring schedule.

Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial disease causing water-soaked lesions on leaves and fruit.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericide. Remove infected plant material.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use disease-free seeds. Avoid working with wet plants. Rotate crops.

Pepper__bell___healthy.description: Plant appears healthy with no signs of disease.
Pepper__bell___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Continue regular care.
Pepper__bell___healthy.prevention: Maintain regular watering, fertilization and monitoring schedule.
